The cargo list is a bare aligned-column table (each cell is its own drawString at a column x position; only a rule above and below the header row), with merged CONSIGNEE section rows (grey fill; text repeated in every column in expected), Subtotal rows and a TOTAL MANIFEST row. It breaks across pages and the header row repeats (listed once). Top key/value block is a four-column borderless form with no header row. Dangerous-goods items have DRAWN check boxes (two ticked) so carry no marker; notes carry typed '1.' markers. Headings are bold capitals in the same monospaced face as the body (sizes 17 / 11.5 / 10.5 against 8.5 body). | Fonts in PDF: standard-14 / not embedded: Courier, Courier-Bold, Courier-Oblique, Helvetica  (the standard-14 Helvetica entry is only ReportLab's default page resource; no document text is set in it)
